meta.source: HACK1984 v6: simplest dark web system, square and quiet

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background: pure black. Space does the separating, not boxes.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The rare filled object (a command box, an open FAQ row). Most cards are just a hairline on ground.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Hover fills, tabs, chips.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Meaningful edges: button hovers, inputs, bracket frames, focus. 3:1+ on ground and surface.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Hairlines at about 10% white: card outlines, row dividers. Decorative only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The 90% white: headlines, names, values. 16:1+ on ground.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: The 60% white: running text. 7.3:1+ on ground and surfaces.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: The 45% white: metadata, captions, dates, keys. 4.7:1+ on ground, surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one red, used in small doses: the square full stop, bracket corners, 1984, the pupil's iris, the selected item, the poster. 5.2:1+ on every dark ground.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on a red fill (black, 5.9:1).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Red-tinted fill behind a featured row or hovered primary button.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The masthead. HACK in ink, 1984 in accent. 0.5em per letter.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section titles: Workbench, sentence case, ending in a red square. Nothing else: no eyebrow, no rule.

styles.name: keyword
styles.usage: One-word keywords that lead a bullet row. Caps, accent or ink.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: The one number to act on, poster-sized, in the red Dialog.

styles.name: statement
styles.sample: Software that treats people like people.
styles.usage: The hero line, once per page. Ends in a red square instead of a full stop. Clamp down to 44px on phones.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Titles inside cards and list rows, ink.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Tier prices, tabular numerals. Accent on the featured tier.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: A hackathon about building software that treats people like people.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Track prize: your team writes the challenge, your engineers judge.
styles.usage: Running copy and bullets, ink-body. Lead-ins in 600 ink.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Tools that don't spy on the person using them.
styles.usage: Descriptions under a card or row title, ink-faint.

styles.name: value
styles.usage: Values in a spec list, ink.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, column heads, small labels. Caps.

styles.name: key
styles.usage: Keys in a spec list, hotkey chips. Caps, ink-faint.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Emails, REM notes, the boot line, the ASCII eye.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon and chip insets; cursor gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding in lists and tables; gap inside a card header.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Grid gaps between cards; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; heading to content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop. Empty space is the main divider.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Above the first section after the hero; before the closing call to action.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: cards, rows, buttons, the poster. Square, like the tile mark.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Reserved; not used on the website.

tokens.name: none
tokens.usage: No shadows or glows on the website. Hairlines and space only.

tokens.name: rule-hair
tokens.usage: All borders and dividers.

tokens.name: rule-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width, in accent, offset 2px.

tokens.name: bracket
tokens.usage: Arm length of the red corner brackets that frame a hero line or a highlighted block.
